body.statement:
If \(S\sim\operatorname{Binomial}(m,\rho)\), the two-sided Clopper--Pearson interval obtained by inversion at noncoverage level \(\gamma\in(0,1)\) satisfies
\[
 \Pr_\rho\{\rho\text{ belongs to the interval based on }S\}\geq1-\gamma
\]
for every \(m\geq1\) and every \(\rho\in[0,1]\); with the convention \([0,1]\) at \(m=0\), coverage is one.

source.locator: pp. 404--413, inversion of the equal-tailed binomial tests

attestation.note: The claim is a specialization of the exact binomial interval construction to one cell conditional on its row total; a DOI is supplied and no verbatim transcription is asserted.
